steps.en: Prepare Python, Ghidra, the bridge and authorized program exports
steps.zh: 准备 Python、Ghidra、桥接器与授权程序导出

steps.en: Initialize the profile; configure provider, source paths and trusted candidate tests
steps.zh: 初始化配置，设置模型、源码路径与可信候选测试

steps.en: Select one function address and start reconstruction
steps.zh: 选一个函数地址，开始重建

steps.en: Collect Ghidra evidence and ask the reverser for candidate C/C++
steps.zh: 收集 Ghidra 证据，让生成器产出候选 C/C++

steps.en: Review and validate the candidate; feed failures into bounded repairs
steps.zh: 评审并验证候选，把失败交回有界修复

steps.en: Save generated code and separate acceptance diagnostics for your integration decision
steps.zh: 保存生成代码与分项验收诊断，供你决定是否集成

value.en: Candidate implementations and failure evidence without manually relaying every review and test result
value.zh: 拿到候选实现与失败证据，不用手工转送每轮评审和测试结果
